templates.title: Product page
templates.summary: a one-page product site with a hero, a feature grid and an FAQ.

collections.name: features
collections.use: Feature cards: the first column is the card heading, the other columns its details.

collections.name: faq
collections.use: Questions and answers: the first column is the question, the other columns the answer.

templates.title: Project page
templates.summary: a project status page with a roadmap table, a backlog table and update cards.

collections.name: roadmap
collections.use: Roadmap milestones as a table, one column per view field.

collections.name: backlog
collections.use: Open backlog items as a table, one column per view field.

templates.title: Documentation
templates.summary: a documentation site with a navigation and one reference page per collection.

collections.name: <any>
collections.use: Every collection gets a reference page under /reference/<name>/ with its fields, their types and every entry.
